text.description_html:
Fusion RH-G2-ORB, Sandcast Brass Round Mount Hook

The Rock Ridge Robe Hook has an oil rubbed bronze finish that really brings out the distressing left behind from the sandcasting. This easy to install robe hook comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware. And although this hook is great for hanging your bath robe, it can be used all over the house. Hang some in the closet or the mudroom to keep purses, bags, hats, and coats off of the floor.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TR-G2 Rock Ridge Towel Ring, Fusion TB-G2 Rock Ridge Towel Bar, and Fusion PH-G2 Rock Ridge Toilet Paper Holder

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Rock Ridge Sandcast Brass Beveled Trim Robe Hook:

  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Mount Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
